Advance Training

Foundational Advantage Competency Advantage Mastery Advantage Collective Advantage Comparison Table

Competency Advantage Professional Certification Track

Everyone can support someone in a conversation. Now, you learn to coach the whole person.

Competency Advantage extends your foundational coaching mindset into advanced professional practice. You learn to engage the whole person — their concerns, values, tensions, and underlying assumptions - so that coaching conversations become spaces where their meaning-making can be seen, questioned, and re-organised.

Grounded in the ICF Core Competencies at the PCC level, you build the capability to respond fluidly rather than follow a script, creating richer, more finely attuned conversations that enable people to change how they see themselves and what they are facing.

This Advantage consolidates your existing strengths into a reliable practice you can draw on when conversations are complex or emotionally charged. Through a focused sequence of labs and mentoring, you refine a way of working you can trust in high-stakes situations and grow into a practitioner whose work carries weight in demanding environments.

Deeper Impact - hold more spacious dialogues where people can work through what truly drives their choices and behaviour.

Shareper Thinking - see what is happening beneath the surface in real time and shape your responses with precision.

Stronger Position - grow your practice against a recognised global benchmark so organisations, clients, and peers trust the quality of your work.

Impactful coaching is about engaging reflectively - enabling insight to emerge, awareness to expand, and to build forward momentum - all in service of meaningful change.

Program Snapshot

Who it's for: People new to coaching, or leaders who want stronger coaching skills in their role.

Time commitment: About 80 learning hours over approximately 24 weeks.

Certification Pathway: This program provides an upgrade to the ICF Level 2 if you have completed an ICF Level 1 Accredited or ACSTH Program, and this meets the requirement for the PCC Credential.

Program Structure

  • Learning Lab :10 Sessions
  • Competency Lab :10 Sessions
  • Practical Lab :12 Sessions
  • Enrichment Lab :3 Sessions
  • Mentoring Lab :3 Sessions
  • Engagement Lab :2 Sessions

Program Description

Learning Lab: Understanding What You Are Working With

This is where you stop guessing why conversations stall, loop in circles, or suddenly go flat. You learn to read the inner logic behind what people say and do in real time. You begin to see the beliefs, values, tensions, and unspoken commitments that quietly organise their reactions.

Drawing on research into how adults make sense of their world, you turn that awareness into a precise coaching skill. You learn to name what is really at stake, focus the conversation where it matters most, and invite clients into clearer, braver choices that fit who they are and what they care about.

Part 1: Seeing the Person Behind the Story

In this module, you learn to listen at the level of sense-making. You begin to notice how a person is constructing their reality in the moment: what they highlight, what they leave out, and what their words reveal about what is at stake for them. We name this stance “I See You" because your listening goes beyond the story to the person trying to make sense of their world. You study how attention, interpretation, and emotion work together as a system, and you practise using this understanding in live dialogue. As your listening becomes more precise, you frame what the client is really working through, reflect the essence of their experience, and create the felt impact of being accurately seen.

 Key Insights You Will Explore

  • How words, tone, and focus reveal what people are really working out beneath the surface.
  • How to separate story detail from the core issue, so you can reflect what genuinely matters to them.
  • How to test and refine your understanding in the moment, so “I See You" feels accurate and respectful.
  • How listening at the level of sense-making sharpens your questions and deepens the impact of each conversation.
Part 2: Facilitating Clarity

Some experiences are hard to put into words. In this module, you learn how to work with those moments. You explore how Clean & Metaphorical Language can open thinking when ordinary questions reach their limit.

Clean Language gives you a disciplined way to stay inside the client's own words while directing attention to the places their mind has not yet gone. You pair this with a practical understanding of how inquiry shapes attention and thinking, so your questions genuinely evoke awareness rather than lead or interpret. These advanced tools add a new dimension to your practice and significantly strengthen your capacity to Evoke Awareness at a PCC level.

 Key Insights You Will Explore

  • How Clean Language questions keep your language aligned with the client's words while guiding attention to what matters most.
  • How to work with client-generated metaphors to reveal and explore complex inner experiences that are difficult to express directly.
  • How to construct questions that slow thinking down, reveal new connections, and support clearer, more coherent decisions.
  • How integrating clean questions and metaphorical exploration creates breakthrough moments of understanding in coaching conversations.
Competency Lab: Knowing What It Looks Like in Practice

This is where the ICF Core Competencies shift from a checklist on paper to a coherent way of coaching. You learn to express the competencies through how you relate, listen, and respond, so you show up more deliberate and grounded, and the PCC markers begin to appear naturally rather than mechanically. Using CMA's framework, you work with the PCC markers in a structured, rigorous way. You clarify what each marker is intended to do, see how it changes the depth and feel of a session, and apply it to real cases with clear guidance and feedback. Many practitioners experience this Lab as a turning point: the design drives accelerated growth and visible breakthroughs in your ability to coach at a globally recognised standard of depth, rigour, and professionalism.

 Learning Highlights

  • Study the ICF Core Competencies and PCC markers as an integrated system shaping the whole coaching conversation.
  • Practise demonstrating the markers in real and simulated cases, so the competencies become a natural expression of your style.
  • Use structured self-review and targeted feedback to refine specific markers while staying present and fluid with your client.
  • Build confidence to live out the competencies with clarity and ease, without trying to recall them during a session.
Practical Lab & Enrichment Lab: Learning by Doing & Observing

This is where you build the confidence to use and adapt it in your real-life context.

Practical Lab: Applying the Approach in Real Conversations
In the Practical Lab, you put the approach into practice through real conversations and structured case studies. You see how the method actually unfolds in practice, build confidence using it in your own context, and receive guidance from an experienced coach supervisor. This helps you link the concepts to live coaching moments and notice the subtleties in coach–client interactions.

Enrichment Lab: Witnessing Mastery in Action
In the Enrichment Lab, you have the rare opportunity to watch mastery in action. You observe the same approach applied at a highly skilled level in a real conversation, with space to reflect on what you are seeing. This gives you a clear picture of how the method works when executed well, and a concrete sense of what to aim for as your own practice grows.

Mentoring Lab: Seeing What You Couldn't See Alone

In the Mentoring Lab, you receive focused feedback on your coaching conversations. Your mentor helps you notice what you did well, what you missed, and how your way of thinking shapes your questions and responses. This kind of guided reflection strengthens your awareness and supports progress that is hard to achieve on your own.
